coolattin: The Coolattin Estate was one of the largest landed estates in County Wicklow, Ireland, owned by the FitzWilliam family and spanning roughly 80,000 acres across the upland baronies of west Wicklow (Shillelagh, Ballinacor Upper and Lower, and parts of Arklow barony). The estate records held in this system document tenancy arrangements, assisted emigration, and evictions primarily between 1827 and 1868, with particularly dense coverage of the Famine decade (1847–1856).
estate: The Coolattin Estate records cover approximately 80 townlands in County Wicklow, Ireland. Data includes pre-Famine rental surveys, clearance (eviction) ledgers for 1847–1856, and emigration departure lists for that same period. The estate was centred on Shillelagh and administered across multiple civil parishes within the baronies of Shillelagh, Ballinacor Upper, and Ballinacor Lower.
famine: The Great Famine (1845–1852) had a severe impact on the Coolattin Estate. Census data shows substantial population decline across most townlands between 1841 and 1851. Estate-assisted emigration peaked between 1847 and 1852, with thousands of tenants departing primarily for Quebec and New York. Clearance records from the same period document the removal of tenants from numerous townlands.
emigration: Estate-assisted emigration from Coolattin was organised by the FitzWilliam estate management and recorded in detailed departure lists. Emigrants typically travelled via Liverpool to Quebec or New York. The records held in this system cover departures between 1847 and 1856 and include names, townland of origin, family size, and destination port where known.
wicklow: County Wicklow lies on the east coast of Ireland, immediately south of Dublin. The Coolattin Estate occupied the upland western part of the county, in and around the Wicklow Mountains. The principal baronies represented in the estate records are Shillelagh, Ballinacor Upper, and Ballinacor Lower. Key civil parishes include Aghold, Moyacomb, Clonmore, Kilcommon, and Carnew.
shillelagh: Shillelagh is both a barony and a civil parish in south-west Wicklow. It forms the administrative heart of the Coolattin Estate and contains the estate's principal settlement. Several townlands in Shillelagh barony appear prominently in the clearance and emigration records.
ballinacor: Ballinacor Upper and Ballinacor Lower are two baronies in County Wicklow that together cover the central upland area of the Coolattin Estate. Many of the most-documented townlands in the estate records fall within these baronies, including those with the largest recorded emigration flows during the Famine period.
